o: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

eps.o: Sonny Cooke, a high school student, awakes from a car accident to discover his mom, Ellen, looks slightly different.
After hiding from his "imposter" mom all weekend, Sonny returns to school determined to find help.
Sonny is forced to stay home with Ellen, so he sets a trap to catch her in her lies.
